paper_title: Searching for Ultralight Dark Matter Conversion in Solar Corona using Low Frequency Array Data
notes: Main result: 95% C.L. upper limit on dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon ~1e-13 over 30-80 MHz (mA' ~1.2e-7 to 3.3e-7 eV) from resonant conversion in solar corona using LOFAR data. Mass from freq via m=4.136e-15*f. Values are approximate reads from Fig.4; the limit is roughly flat near 1e-13. Assumes rho_DM=0.3 GeV/cm^3 and rho_A'=rho_DM. Paper also derives an axion-photon coupling limit (Fig.10) but that is weaker/secondary; DarkPhoton is the primary result. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
